newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Wolters Kluwer expands in Austria.
newsitem.headline: Wolters Kluwer expands in Austria.

text.p: Dutch publisher Wolters Kluwer NV said on Tuesday its unit Bohmann Druck had made two acquisitions in Austria.
It bought an 80 percent stake in D+R Verlag and also took over all of Verlag Monitor.
Both companies are based in Vienna, Wolters Kluwer said.
Wolters Kluwer said Verlag Monitor was a leading publisher in the area of information technology and communications while D+R Verlag specialises in tourism and travel publications.
The Dutch group said the two companies had a combined annual turnover of some 11 million guilders or 67 million Austrian schillings and a combined staff of 31 people.
Wolters Kluwer said the acquisitions were in line with its strategy to further strengthen its position in business publishing in local markets.
